contract:
Issue #6 Done when: board with legal-move enforcement, a move list and takebacks; the bot replies within 2 seconds (NFR-3); finished and abandoned games are saved as PGN (FR-5); an end-to-end browser test plays a few moves automatically, in CI; tests pass in CI. Scope addition: the server reads repertoire/london.pgn and repertoire/kid.pgn at startup and fails with a clear message if one is missing or doesn't parse. Note on #6: node:sqlite's ExperimentalWarning is silenced at server start.

The contract is packages/chess-core/src/api.ts at 46b1de2 (read it with git show). Key rules: 409 for takeback while bot thinking / not playing / nothing to undo; 409 for a move when not the player's turn, bot thinking or game not playing; 400 illegal or malformed; 404 unknown; creating a game abandons and saves a playing one; first SSE message on every connection is state.

Implementation decisions given to the spokes: no or empty LICHESS_TOKEN -> warning + stub explorer, engine-only bot; DB_PATH default <repo>/data/chess-tutor.sqlite, ':memory:' works; games saved when finished or abandoned (new game, or SIGINT/SIGTERM shutdown); PGN Seven Tag Roster with Player / Sparring bot and endReason; a bot result that arrives after the game changed is discarded; a bot error -> SSE error event, game stays playing with botThinking false. Web: server is the authority, client chess.js only for legal targets, snap back after a 400, board locked while botThinking or not playing, auto-queen promotion acceptable, EventSource closed on new game/unmount; Playwright webServer runs real server on PORT=3101 DB_PATH=:memory: LICHESS_TOKEN='' and vite on 5174.

Spoke-reported choices to judge: server sends an extra 'state' event after player moves and takebacks, and game_over to an abandoned game's subscribers; server listens on host 'localhost'; empty JSON body accepted as no body; server has its own copy of strict UCI validation because chess-core does not export playUci; the client distinguishes SSE event 'error' (GameEvent) from EventSource connection errors by presence of ev.data; Playwright API webServer readiness is a TCP port check.
